input: Write a personal development book review for my blog

gold.taskTitle: Write a Personal Development Book Review for Blog
gold.taskDescription: Write and publish a book review in the personal development genre for the user's blog.

questions.title: Which specific book are you reviewing?
questions.description: Identify the exact title and author of the personal development book to be reviewed.

questions.title: Who is the target audience reading your blog?
questions.description: Understand the demographic and interests of the blog's readership to tailor the tone and depth of the review.

questions.title: What is the word count you are aiming for?
questions.description: Determine the desired length of the review to scope the writing effort appropriately.

questions.title: Have you already finished reading the book?
questions.description: Confirm whether the user has completed the book or needs to account for reading time before writing.

questions.title: What tone does your blog typically use?
questions.description: Clarify whether the blog's voice is formal, conversational, motivational, critical, or something else.

questions.title: What specific angle or theme should the review focus on?
questions.description: Determine if the review should highlight a particular aspect such as actionability, storytelling, scientific backing, or overall rating.

questions.title: When does this review need to be published?
questions.description: Establish the deadline or target publish date to prioritize and schedule the task correctly.
